english.title: Infringe a performer's making available right in a recording
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) infringed a performer's making available right in a recording knowing or having reason to believe that you had infringed that right, and
(A)_[intending to make a gain for yourself or another person]_
(B)_[that infringing the right would cause loss to the owner of the right, or expose the owner of the right to a risk of loss]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 198(1A) and (5A) of the Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
infringed a performer's making available right in a recording
when knowing / having reason to believe
that you had infringed that right AND

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
Subsection 198(1B) states -
For the purposes of subsection (1A) -
(a) 'gain' and 'loss' -
(i) extend only to gain or loss in money, and (ii) include any such gain or loss whether temporary or permanent, and (b) 'loss' includes a loss by not getting what one might get.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment and / or fine.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
